title: Bound scientific-notation counts before queue pricing
body:
## Summary

Queue pricing limits count strings to 60 characters, but `Fraction` expands scientific notation before the numeric range check. The eight-character count `1e-10000` therefore passes validation with a 33,220-bit denominator; larger exponents can scale the work despite the advertised bounded metadata budget.

Check the decimal exponent before calling `Fraction`, including its supported underscore and Unicode-digit spellings. Counts retain the existing 60-character limit and now have an explicit exponent budget of -60 through 60 and a reduced numerator/denominator magnitude limit of `10^60`. The existing value range of 0 through `10^9` remains. Ordinary bounded integer, fraction, decimal and scientific spellings still preserve exact values; formerly accepted scientific inputs beyond the new budget are left unpriced as `unknown_or_outside_model`.

The real CLI regression contains an oversized profile and a healthy neighbor. The oversized profile now carries the budget diagnostic, while the healthy reference retains the exact primitive ceiling `1690054109089/1000000000000000`. This is an input-resource bound, not a mathematical rejection of a construction. The retained ceiling implementation and selected result are unchanged.

Builds on Douglas R. Colkitt's queue-grouping implementation in [d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641), at canonical base `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`. Substantial implementation and independent review assistance was provided by OpenAI Codex.

## Test plan

- [x] `python3.12 -B tests/test_research_queue_groups.py` — 14 tests pass on Python 3.12.14; the same suite passes on Python 3.11.6.
- [x] Safe allocation sentinels confirm positive/negative oversized exponents, zero mantissas, underscore exponents and Unicode digits are rejected before `Fraction` is called. Controls cover exact ordinary spellings, `1e-60`, zero at both exponent boundaries, expanded-component limits and the existing numeric range.
- [x] Actual CLI tests report each over-budget profile while pricing its healthy neighbor; the bounded `1e-10000` before/after fixture confirms the old acceptance and new diagnostic without a large resource-exhaustion test.
- [x] Read-only planning over all 1,629 registered manifests selects no package for these three changed files; no registered live input consumer or source pin was found. No contribution replay or blanket historical suite was run.
- [x] `git diff --check` passes.

Overlap: the complete metadata snapshot covered 344 open PRs, 2,959 closed/merged PRs and 2,453 Discussion records. Targeted queue-pricing/scientific-notation searches found no equivalent fix; the subsequent updated-PR check contained no overlapping tooling change. These searches cover metadata, not arbitrary diffs.

Hosted CI has not yet run; local tests do not imply maintainer acceptance. Prepared by roger-sato with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
